issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (task description and UML) specifies a method addGuestStudents(int, String) that takes an int (number of new guest students) and a String (reason). The solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) with only the int parameter. This discrepancy between the specified API and the implemented signature will confuse students and will break automated tests or example code that call addGuestStudents with two arguments (causing compilation or test failures).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent with the problem statement/UML. Update the implementation to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and modify the method body to add numberOfNewGuestStudents to numberOfGuestStudents (and optionally record or log the reason, or add a comment explaining why the reason is ignored). Alternatively, if the reason parameter is intentionally not needed, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) only and update template and tests accordingly. Prefer adding the String parameter to the implementation to match the current specification.
